receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  otlp_http:
    endpoint: ${AC_OTEL_ENDPOINT:-http://host.docker.internal:4318}
    encoding: json
    # The receiver cannot read a gzip-encoded body: with the exporter's
    # default compression it answers `400 SyntaxError: JSON Parse error`.
    compression: none
    tls:
      insecure: true
  # Prints one line per exported batch, so `docker logs
  # grid-allocation-backend-otel-collector` shows what the app exported.
  debug:
    verbosity: basic
service:
  telemetry:
    logs:
      level: info
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp_http, debug]
    logs:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp_http, debug]
